What you need to do is look at the pipes with your focus being on everyday practicality and by that I mean does it have a screen that needs cleaning every few hits? How about hard to reach areas that will require soaking in alcohol for days to properly clean? Is there anything to stop embers from flying down your throat? etc. Using logic like that will remove 90% or more of available pieces as an option and then your financial restrictions will likely take care of the rest but do keep in mind that if you take good care of an everyday bong it can serve you for decades so spend that little extra to get the piece you truly want.

Wooden pipes can be used for weed, but I recommend you get some wire screens to put about halfway down so that you don't have to fill the entire bowl with bud (tobacco pipes have considerably larger bowls).

Check out a local glass shop if there is one around you and just browse until you find something you like. I have found that local artistry is usually the best way to get a decent pipe for a fair price, as intricate factory glass tends to be overpriced, while cheap factory glass is often tacky and uninteresting.

Source: I own a lot of pipes
